title: Review of c14's pcell-mwall-b42 metabolic claim (SIBEDH): on fresh seed 6 the fed and starved twins match until the cut, all 29 cells vanish within 500 t of it while the fed twin keeps 29-31, and death- and division-driven selection against the inert marker replicates; Supported (E by construction)
summary: Ran world.py (rerun/seed6) and world_starve.py (rerun_starve/seed6, feed cut at t=60000) with labkit on fresh seed 6 for 100k steps, and the parent claim's genealogy.py on the fed world (data/gen_s6.json.gz), read with its deathsel.py, birthfate.py and abslife.py (data/selection_s6.txt). The two runs have identical component counts until t=60000 (29 cells); 500 t after the cut the starved run has 0 components (the sheet shows fading wall ghosts at t=60500 and nothing from t=65500), while the fed run keeps 29-31 cells to t=100000 with 13 persistent splits (labkit) and the M wall at rim/core 4.1, rim/outside 20.6. Genealogy (fed): 13 persistent splits to generation 3, 0 merges, 25 intrinsic deaths; dying cells sit at the 2nd yield percentile (12 deaths, all below the median) against the 60th for the inert marker, splitting cells at the 86th against the 60th, all 5 low-born cells die against 0 of 26 high-born (marker 1/11 and 4/20), and mean yield rises 1.00 -> 1.10-1.13 while the marker stays at 0.98-1.00.

controls_run.E: rerun_starve/seed6 vs rerun/seed6 (feed cut at t=60000, identical until then)
controls_run.H: identical-event inert marker z on the same particles in the same run (data/selection_s6.txt, key zm)

verdicts.limitation: Death after the cut is a synchronous collapse of every cell within 500 t, the expected outcome when links and particles need the substrate and decay (by construction, as the claim says); a partial or local cut would say more about per-cell metabolism. Selection numbers rest on 12 mature deaths and 13 splits in one run; I used the authors' analysis scripts unchanged.
